steps.label: Initial action
steps.sub: close it, escalate it, or contain it

code:
Alert: "admin login from a new country"

Checked raw auth log -> login confirmed, real, as described

Traveling for a conference, IT ticket confirms it
  -> BENIGN TRUE POSITIVE (real activity, not malicious)

Same alert, 3am local time, then a failed MFA-device add
  -> TRUE POSITIVE (real activity, malicious)
caption: The alert label alone never tells you which one it is -- only the underlying data does.

steps.label: Too slow
